checks.name: Primary Key Uniqueness
checks.description: Verifies that every primary key in all 10 entities is unique without collision.

checks.name: Foreign Key Integrity
checks.description: Validates that all foreign key references resolve to valid parent master records.

checks.name: Missing Values & Null Constraints
checks.description: Checks that mandatory operational fields contain non-null values.

checks.name: Categorical Enum Validation
checks.description: Asserts all state and category columns conform to allowed domain enums.

checks.name: Date Chronology Verification
checks.description: Confirms timestamp sequences obey causality (e.g. signup <= start <= churn).

checks.name: Subscription Lifecycle Consistency
checks.description: Checks consistency between subscription status, termination timestamps, and reasons.

checks.name: Monetary Calculation Checks
checks.description: Validates non-negative constraints on recurring revenues and invoice amounts.

checks.name: Payment Reconciliation
checks.description: Verifies that transaction status exactly matches settled payment totals.

checks.name: Duplicate Telemetry Detection
checks.description: Asserts no duplicate monthly snapshots exist per subscription.

checks.name: Offer Eligibility Gate Compliance
checks.description: Ensures no treatment retention offer was delivered to an ineligible subscriber (EC-02).

checks.name: Experiment Partition Purity & Contamination Guard
checks.description: Confirms Treatment and Control groups are mutually exclusive without leakage (EC-03).

checks.name: Retention Attribution Integrity
checks.description: Validates that customers receiving multiple offers have documented attribution flags (EC-04).

checks.name: Temporal Leakage Audit
checks.description: Audits feature extraction time barrier to ensure zero forward data leakage (EC-01).
